name: create-issue
description: Creates a Linear issue (a ticket) in a team, with an optional Markdown description, priority, assignee, workflow state, labels, project and cycle. The team comes from linear__list-teams, the assignee from linear__list-users, the state from linear__list-workflow-states, the labels from linear__list-labels, the project from linear__list-projects and the cycle from linear__list-cycles.

teamId.description: The team the issue is created in: a team's id from linear__list-teams.

priority.description: Priority: 0 none, 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 medium, or 4 low.

assigneeId.description: Who the issue is assigned to: a user's id from linear__list-users.

stateId.description: The workflow state the issue starts in: a state's id from linear__list-workflow-states, of the same team. Omitted, the team's default.

labelIds.description: Labels for the issue: label ids from linear__list-labels.

projectId.description: The project the issue belongs to: a project's id from linear__list-projects.

cycleId.description: The cycle the issue is planned in: a cycle's id from linear__list-cycles.
